title: Drive Finish High (Michelle Grogan)
style: funk-rnb-reggaeton-cumbia-dnb fusion 134bpm slap bass Rhodes sax horns dembow marimba guiro congas dnb chorus beatbox claps English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Intro]
Drive finish high drive finish high
Watch the paddle tip up to the sky
Drive finish high drive finish high
Thats how the drive shot will fly

[Verse 1]
Low to high the path of the drive
Paddle tip ends above where the eyes arrive
Never stop the swing at contact
Finish high keeps the line intact
Vamos vamos finish strong
High paddle tip carries the song
Drive shot finish over the front line
Topspin born in the rise climb

[Pre-Chorus]
Finish high finish high
Reach for the sky
Finish high finish high
Let the drive fly

[Chorus]
Drive finish high keep the swing long
Drive finish high never go wrong
Drive finish high paddle to the cloud
Drive finish high say it loud
Vamos vamos pa lante
Finish high
Vamos vamos pa lante
Let it fly

[Verse 2]
Forehand drive finish across the body
Backhand drive finish over the shoulder steady
Same finish line same paddle path
Thats the topspin physics math
Uno dos tres reach up high
Follow through never shy
Drive deep at the feet of the foe
Finish high every blow

[Bridge]
Common error stopping at the ball
Finish line is what makes the shot tall
Let the paddle ride to the highest point
Thats how the topspin gets the joint

[Chorus]
Drive finish high keep the swing long
Drive finish high never go wrong
Drive finish high paddle to the cloud
Drive finish high say it loud

[Outro]
Drive finish high drive finish high
Watch the paddle tip up to the sky
Drive finish high drive finish high
Thats how the drive shot will fly
